newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate flat at 48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate flat at 48 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week funds remained flat at 48 percent at this week's refinancing auction.
The BNR's offer of 1.53 trillion lei was undersubscribed by six commercial banks which entered 1.525 trillion worth of bids at prices equal with the minimum permitted rate.
On Thursday, the central bank lowered the one-week funds available by 20 billion lei from a previous 1.55 trillion.

Prices for money market funds up to one-week stayed near 40 percent while two-week rates hovered at around 46 percent. Auction results are on FXRP. ($=3,394 lei) -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
